**Course Description**  
**Faculty of Sharia**  
**B.A Program in Imam (leading prayers), Khatabah (giving sermons) / Male Students**

---

**040001010 Ethics and Skills of University Life**  
*(0 Credit Hours)*  
Students who enroll in this course will discuss ethical issues and skills of university life with the vice presidents and deans of the faculties. The discussion will be interactive, aiming for a deep understanding of these issues, their principles, and applying this understanding in university life.  

The course covers principles, values, and ethical rules that guide university life, equipping students with skills to adapt and thrive personally and academically. It provides the background and reference for the main features that guide university life, emphasizing the contract of ethics and manners that each student must commit to and be responsible for, ultimately shaping student behavior and daily practices.

---

**0401111 Qur'anic Sciences**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course familiarizes students with various aspects of Qur'anic studies, including: revelation, history and reasons of revelation, translation, inimitability of the Qur'an, manuscripts, abrogation, recitations, and refutations of accusations against the Qur'an, as well as exegesis bases.

---

**0401112 Recitation & Memorization / 1**  
*(1 Credit Hour)*  
This course enables students to recite the Qur'an according to recitation rules. It involves the development of recitation skills and practical training in reciting chapters (21-30), including emphasis on specific assimilation rules for memorizing sections 29 and 30.

---

**0401121 Hadith Sciences**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course includes an introduction to Hadith and the work of Hadith scholars, discussing the development of Hadith studies, types of Hadith, and scholarly work in Hadith. It also covers the bases for accepting and rejecting Hadith.

---
